instruction: These hypotheses are not mutually exclusive. More than one may contribute. Assign each an independent probability.

hypotheses.label: Measurement artefact
hypotheses.claim: The affinity differences are not real; the reported binding ranking does not reflect genuine differences between the clones.

hypotheses.label: Antigen density limits benefit
hypotheses.claim: Higher affinity cannot help when target antigen is sparse; the durability difference is set by how much antigen the target cells carry.

hypotheses.label: Self-targeting during manufacture
hypotheses.claim: The construct's own carriers express the antigen, so higher affinity destroys the product before it is infused.

hypotheses.label: Chronic activation
hypotheses.claim: Sustained engagement drives a dysfunctional phenotype that fails on repeated challenge.
